## Try It Out!
### Send admin email alerts for new Sharetribe listings via Gmail

Notify marketplace admins when new listings are created. This workflow handles both published listings and listings pending approval, routing them to separate email notifications so admins can take action.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `listing/updated` events (listings pass through multiple states during creation).
* An IF node checks the listing state — routing `pendingApproval` listings to an urgent approval notification, and `published` listings to a standard notification.
* The Asset Get node retrieves your marketplace's email template text.
* Gmail sends the appropriate notification to your admin email.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Gmail account.
3. Update the "To" field in both Gmail nodes with your admin email address.
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Gmail account

### How to customize
* If your marketplace doesn't require listing approval, remove the pendingApproval branch.
* Add listing details (title, description) by including the `resource` field in the trigger output.
* Replace Gmail with Slack for team channel notifications.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for listing updates
Polls for `listing/updated` events. New listings go through state changes (draft → pendingApproval → published), so we filter on the update event.

## 2. Check listing state
Routes the event based on listing state. Pending approval listings need urgent admin attention, while published listings are informational.

## 3. Send notification
Sends the appropriate email based on the listing state. Pending approval emails include a link to the Console for review.
